target.title: fix(mattermost): cap opaque, outbound, and monitor resource caches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long-running Mattermost gateways could accumulate unbounded in-process lookup caches for opaque target resolution, outbound send path lookups, and monitor channel/user resources, increasing memory use over time on busy instances.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `pruneMapToMaxSize` bounds to the Mattermost plugin's opaque-target cache (1024 entries), outbound send caches (bot/user/channel/DM lookups at 256–1024 entries), and monitor resource caches (1000 channel/user entries). Cache refresh keeps recently used keys and evicts oldest entries once caps are exceeded, matching the pattern used in other channel plugins.

## User Impact

Operators running Mattermost channels on long-lived gateways get bounded memory for these lookup caches. Send and monitor behavior is unchanged for normal workloads; only the oldest cached entries are evicted under sustained high-cardinality traffic.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-mattermost.config.ts` — 42 files, 525 tests passed
- New eviction tests in `target-resolution.test.ts` and `monitor-resources.test.ts` verify oldest entries are re-fetched after the cap is exceeded


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
